title: Google Drive Slideshow
errorTitle: Google Drive Slideshow could not load
imageFailed: The selected Google Drive photo could not be displayed.
authOverlayMessage: Open this paper’s settings on your phone. Verify the API key and public folder link, or your service account key, folder share, and selected folder.
emptyFolderMessage: Add JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF photos to the folder root (not in subfolders), then refresh this paper.
settingsIntro: Choose a public link folder or a private folder shared with your own service account.
publicSetupHelp: Before you continue, create a Google API key with the Drive API enabled and share the folder as Anyone with the link → Viewer.
privateSetupHelp: Use your own Google Cloud project: enable the Drive API, create a service account, download its JSON key, and paste it below.
privateShareHelp: Share your photo folder with the service account email as Viewer, then load folders and pick one.
noFoldersFound: No folders found. Share a folder with the service account email first.
